title: oldenlandia fruticosa

This plant is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of Oldenlandia fruticosa include its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its potential to lower blood sugar levels and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
